Patient Demographics¶

The Patient Demographics module collects essential identifying and demographic information about patients. This information serves as the foundation for all other data collected in the CHAVI system.

Data Collection Fields¶

Patient Identification¶

  • Patient ID: Your institution’s medical record number or another consistent identifier used by your center. This is the primary identifier for the patient in the system.

CHAVI Consent Information¶

  • CHAVI Consent: Indicates whether the patient has provided consent for their data to be used in the CHAVI project (Yes/No)

  • Date of CHAVI Consent: The date when the patient provided consent for the CHAVI project

Basic Demographics¶

  • Gender: Patient’s gender (options: Male, Female, Transgender, Non-Binary)

  • Date of Birth: Patient’s date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format * If only age is known: Use January 1st of the calculated birth year * Example: For a 20-year-old patient registered on March 21, 2020, enter 2000-01-01 as the date of birth

Registration Information¶

  • Date of Registration: The date when the patient was first registered at your hospital

  • Project Assignment: One or more CHAVI projects the patient is enrolled in

Special Considerations¶

  1. When exact birth date is unknown:

    1. Use January 1st as the default month and day

    2. Calculate the year based on the patient’s age at registration

    3. Document that this is an approximated date

  2. Project assignments:

    1. Patients can be enrolled in multiple projects

    2. Project assignments can be updated as needed

    3. Each project may have different data collection requirements

  3. Patient ID:

    1. Must be consistent with your institution’s records

    2. Will be used to link all patient data in the system

    3. Will be unique for the center
